parameters.message:
={{ '📋 *Application Fill Guide Ready*

🏢 *' + $json.company + '*
💼 ' + $json.job_title + '
🔗 ' + $json.job_url + '

📝 *Steps:*
' + $json.steps + '

⏱ Est. time: ' + $json.estimated_minutes + ' min

📊 Pre-filled answers + cover letter in Application Tracker sheet!

✍️ *Cover Letter Excerpt:*
' + ($json.cover_letter || '').substring(0, 280) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, company: $json.company, job_title: $json.job_title, form_type: $json.form_type, fields_count: Object.keys($json.fields || {}).length, estimated_minutes: $json.estimated_minutes, message: 'Fill guide generated and saved. Check Application Tracker sheet and WhatsApp.' }) }}

meta.description: Analyzes a job application form URL with GPT-4o-mini, pre-fills all fields using Yahya's profile, writes a tailored cover letter, saves everything to Application Tracker Google Sheet, and sends a WhatsApp guide. TRIGGER: POST to /webhook/job-apply with JSON body { job_url, job_title, company_name }. Can also be triggered from WhatsApp bot via 'apply [URL]' command. SETUP: (1) Replace YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY in OpenAI Form Analysis node. (2) Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SPREADSHEET_ID in Log to Application Tracker node and connect Google Sheets credential. (3) Replace YOUR_TWILIO_CREDENTIAL_ID and YOUR_WHATSAPP_NUMBER in WhatsApp Alert node. (4) Fill in YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER, YOUR_UNIVERSITY etc. in the profile object inside Build Analysis Prompt node.
